rawContent: •35% - Among people who were unarmed and killed by police during 2017, Blacks accounted for 35 percent of those deaths. This rate is nearly three times higher than the nation’s overall Black population, which is about 13 percent. #BLM

Tulsa has a nearly 11-year life expectancy difference between ZIP codes in north & south Tulsa. This problem is not new. The latest protests for #BlackLivesMatter and COVID-19 have enlarged these inequalities. We need to engage with one another to start addressing these problems.

Several Tulsa houses of worship display 'Black Lives Matter' on anniversary of Terence Crutcher's death: Religious leaders from Tulsa’s churches and temples gathered at a midtown church to issue a proclamation: Black lives matter. #BLM Churches honor #BLM, as we all should.
